prisoner.name: Andres Valencia
prisoner.description: Andres Valencia was held by US military authorities at Balayan, Batangas, during the Philippine-American War. The Army register associated the detention with alleged insurgency. The record documents sustained custody followed by release in March 1901.

cases.charges: US military detention for alleged insurgency; no criminal conviction established
cases.sentence: Released on account of sickness. Earlier rolls say November 27 capture; the March column carries November 24. Month precision retains the conflict. No individual criminal sentence established for this custody period.

prisoner.name: Cornelio de Jesus
prisoner.description: Cornelio de Jesus was held by US military authorities at Balayan, Batangas, during the Philippine-American War. The Army register associated the detention with alleged insurgency. The record documents sustained custody followed by release in March 1901.

cases.charges: US military detention for alleged insurgency; no criminal conviction established
cases.sentence: Classified by the military as an insurgent and released after a rifle was brought in. No individual criminal sentence established for this custody period.
